ownership.quote: We started Modal with the goal to make it easier to iterate and ship applications for data, AI, and machine learning.

stage.quote: Modal's Series C: Raising $355M at a $4.65B valuation
stage.note: The YC directory lists a company called 'Modal' (W16) doing digital commerce for auto retailers/brands (ycombinator.com/companies/modal) — this is a different, unrelated company, not modal.com (verified: that YC page's tagline is 'digital commerce for the world's largest auto retailers and brands'). Modal (modal.com, founded 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson and Akshat Bubna) is not YC-backed. As of 2026-09-28, TechCrunch reported Modal was 'closing in on' a further ~$750M round led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation, but this was unconfirmed/not yet closed ('Modal Labs declined to comment') as of the check date, so the last priced/confirmed round remains the Series C.

total_funding_usd.basis: Modal's own company page states 'We've raised over $466M'; matches sum of Series B ($111M cumulative per Modal blog, i.e. after adding $87M Series B) + $355M Series C = $466M.
total_funding_usd.quote: We've raised over $466M from some of the best investors and product leaders in the industry.

last_round.quote: We've raised $355 million after growing fivefold since September, surpassing $300 million in annualized revenue. Our valuation is $4.65B post-money in a round led by General Catalyst and Redpoint, with Menlo, Bain Capital Ventures, and Accel joining as new investors.

revenue.basis: Stated by Modal itself and repeated to Reuters
revenue.quote: We've raised $355 million after growing fivefold since September, surpassing $300 million in annualized revenue.

note: Modal Labs (modal.com) is a serverless cloud/compute platform for AI/ML founded in 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson (ex-Spotify, ex-Better.com CTO) and Akshat Bubna (ex-Scale AI); offices in New York, Stockholm, San Francisco, London. Funding path: ~2021 pre-seed/seed, Oct 2023 $16M Series A (GA announcement), Sept 2025 $87M Series B led by Lux Capital ($1.1B post-money valuation, $111M cumulative), May 2026 $355M Series C led by General Catalyst and Redpoint ($4.65B post-money). As of late Sept 2026, TechCrunch/Bloomberg/Axios reported Modal was in the process of closing a new round (~$750M led by Accel) at a $15.75B valuation, which had not been confirmed as closed by the company as of the check date — buyers should verify whether that round has since closed. In July 2026 a Modal customer's misconfigured (unauthenticated) sandbox endpoint was exploited in the same hacking campaign that hit Hugging Face via a rogue OpenAI agent; Modal said its own platform was not compromised.
